name: io.github.wonderpick/apify-b2b-ecom-automation-kit
title: Apify External Business Intelligence MCP Server
description: 11 external-intel tools & 9 prompts: App Store churn, ATS hiring, Meta Ads, B2B, Shopify & SOC 2.

tools.name: extract_brand_store_stockists
tools.description: Extract retail stockists carrying external brands and enrich each store domain with verified buyer emails and DNS deliverability checks. Supply at least one source (urls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId); omitting all sources returns 0 items at $0. Optional filters (onlyIndependentStores, onlyWithEmail, minReadinessScore) gate billing before charge, while maxStoresPerBrand (1-5,000) bounds fan-out per brand. Bills $5/1K stores ($0 when empty or filtered), runs ~15-60s per brand with per-store failure isolation in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and optionally posts to webhookUrl. Use for wholesale retail prospecting; do not use for editing your own store map or enriching corporate B2B companies (use enrich_b2b_company_leads instead).

urls.description: Competitor brand homepages or store locator URLs, e.g. ["https://fellowproducts.com", "https://brooklynhotdogcompany.com"]. Optional when rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId is provided.

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated brand/locator URLs.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL containing brand or store locator URLs.

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

enrichEmails.description: Visit each unique retailer website (plus /wholesale and /contact) to extract buyer emails and social links.

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only stores where at least one valid email is found ($0 otherwise).

onlyIndependentStores.description: When true, skip national chains (Target, Walmart, Sephora, Whole Foods, etc.) at $0 and return independent boutiques and regional shops.

maxStoresPerBrand.description: Maximum stockist locations to return per brand (1-5,000).

countryFilter.description: Optional country code or name filter, e.g. "US", "GB", "CA", "AU", "DE", or "KR".

minReadinessScore.description: Minimum outreachReadinessScore (0-100) required to save and bill ($0 for filtered stores).

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset while preserving standard fields.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL notified with run metrics and top stockists on completion.

tools.name: monitor_shopify_competitor_deltas
tools.description: Monitor up to 50 external Shopify competitor stores (up to 2,500 products each) for price, stock, catalog, and MAP changes against persisted Key-Value Store snapshots. Requires storeUrls; minPriceChangePercent and mapFloorPrices drive CRITICAL alerts, while stateStoreName isolates snapshots per workflow (avoid concurrent runs on the same stateStoreName to prevent race overwrites). Persists snapshot state and optional webhookUrl alerts (explaining readOnlyHint=false), isolating per-store or webhook failures in OUTPUT_SUMMARY without aborting the run. Bills $2/1K real deltas ($0 on baseline or unchanged runs). Use for recurring Shopify SKU tracking; do not use for editing your Shopify admin, Meta ad audits (use audit_meta_ads_advertisers), or retail stockists (use extract_brand_store_stockists).

storeUrls.description: List of 1 to 50 external Shopify store or collection URLs, e.g. ["https://www.allbirds.com"].

stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store (alphanumeric and hyphens only) used to persist snapshots between runs.

maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum products to fetch per store URL (50-2,500, paginated at 250/page).

minPriceChangePercent.description: Minimum percentage change threshold (0-100) before emitting price_drop or price_increase.

eventTypes.description: Optional subset of catalog or pricing event types to emit.

mapThresholds.description: Optional map of SKU or product handle to Minimum Advertised Price (flags mapViolation: true and severity: CRITICAL if below threshold).

emitBaselineSummary.description: Emit 1 zero-cost baseline_initialized summary on the first snapshot of each store.

webhookUrl.description: Optional Slack, Discord, or n8n webhook URL notified when at least 1 delta occurs.

tools.name: audit_saas_trust_center
tools.description: Audit or monitor up to 500 external SaaS vendor Trust Centers for security certifications, DNS IAM/SSO, and third-party/AI subprocessors. Requires domains (empty input returns 0 items at $0); mode="audit" runs statelessly, while mode="monitor" diffs against stateStoreName snapshots and emitBaselineSummary controls first-run output. Persists monitor snapshots and optional webhookUrl alerts (explaining readOnlyHint=false), isolating per-domain 403/timeout failures in OUTPUT_SUMMARY. Bills $5/1K audited domains or real changes ($0 when unchanged or WAF-blocked). Use for TPRM vendor risk or finding SaaS vendors lacking SOC 2; do not use for editing internal GRC workspaces or local SMB website audits (use audit_local_b2b_websites instead).

domains.description: List of 1 to 500 external SaaS vendor or prospect domains, e.g. ["apify.com", "linear.app"].

mode.description: "audit" returns complete security posture immediately; "monitor" compares against snapshots and emits only real changes ($0 unchanged).

stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist baseline snapshots in monitor mode.

checkSubprocessors.description: Inspect /subprocessors pages and Trust Center content for third-party and AI vendors.

checkDnsIam.description: Query DNS CNAME/TXT/MX records to verify Trust Center hosting and SSO/IAM providers.

emitBaselineSummary.description: In monitor mode, emit 1 zero-cost baseline_initialized summary record per domain on its first run.

webhookUrl.description: Optional Slack, Discord, or n8n webhook URL notified in monitor mode when compliance or AI subprocessor changes occur.

tools.name: enrich_b2b_company_leads
tools.description: Resolve company names, domains, or work emails into verified official websites, LinkedIn company pages, business emails, and DNS deliverability grades. Supply at least one source (inputs, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId; omitting all returns 0 items at $0); datasetField selects the upstream column, minConfidence sets name-match strictness, and onlyWithEmail or includeUnresolved=false drops misses before billing. Streams in 50-item chunks (~10-45s per 100 companies) with per-company error isolation in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, optional webhookUrl delivery, and $2.50/1K enriched billing ($0 for parked, unresolved, or filtered skips). Use for B2B corporate enrichment; do not use for creator link-in-bio pages (use enrich_creator_bio_leads instead).

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated company names, domains, URLs, or work emails.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL (auto-detects website, domain, companyName, name, or email fields).

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

datasetField.description: Optional explicit field name to read from datasetId/sourceRunId items when chaining.

enrichContactPages.description: Follow up to 2 internal /contact or /about pages when the homepage lacks emails or LinkedIn.

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only companies where at least 1 verified email is found ($0 otherwise).

includeUnresolved.description: Include unresolved/not_found rows in the dataset for auditability (always $0 cost).

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for accepting company-name-to-domain matches.

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset while preserving standard fields.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL notified with run metrics and top leads on completion.

tools.name: enrich_creator_bio_leads
tools.description: Enrich creator Link-in-Bio pages across 15+ bio platforms with agency or business emails, DNS deliverability checks, and sponsorship readiness scores. Supply at least one source (urls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId; omitting all returns 0 items at $0); enableDeepContactFollow toggles 1-hop personal-site crawling, while onlyWithEmail and minReadinessScore gate billing before charge. Streams up to 50,000 profiles in 50-item chunks at $2.50/1K enriched ($0 on 404, WAF, or filtered skips), isolating per-profile failures in OUTPUT_SUMMARY with optional webhookUrl delivery. sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

enableDeepContactFollow.description: When no email is on the bio page, follow up to 2 personal website, Contact, or Media Kit links (1-hop, SSRF-safe, Cloudflare decoding included).

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) on custom creator/agency email domains.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only creators with at least 1 valid email ($0 when missing).

minReadinessScore.description: Minimum Creator Brand-Deal Readiness Score (0-100) required to save and bill.

maxProfiles.description: Maximum unique creator bio URLs to process (1-50,000).

maxConcurrency.description: Concurrent requests (1-20; capped automatically on 128-256 MB containers).

tools.name: search_korea_mfds_recalls
tools.description: Search official South Korea MFDS cosmetic recall and sales-suspension orders in English or Korean. Filter inputs accept English or Korean terms (50+ K-Beauty terms like "sunscreen", "soap", and "Cosmax" auto-translate server-side); omitting all filters returns recent orders up to maxItems (default 100), and onlyActiveRecalls excludes lifted orders before billing. Queries the live MFDS public API (~2-10s) with automatic retries on transient gateway errors and bills $3/1K matches ($0 if none). Use for K-Beauty import safety and recall screening; do not use for US FDA/EU recalls or functional OEM factory discovery (use search_korea_mfds_oem_filings instead).

companyName.description: Optional brand or manufacturer filter in English or Korean, e.g. "Cosmax", "Cowell", or "코스맥스".

productName.description: Optional product keyword in English or Korean, e.g. "sunscreen", "soap", "lip balm", or "선크림".

onlyActiveRecalls.description: When true, return and bill only currently active recall orders (hiding expired notices at $0).

businessNumber.description: Optional Korean 10-digit business registration number (hyphens ignored), e.g. "2158733119".

recallOrderDateFrom.description: Optional start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2025-01-01".

recallOrderDateTo.description: Optional end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-12-31".

tools.name: search_korea_mfds_oem_filings
tools.description: Search 219,000+ official South Korea MFDS functional cosmetic filings in English or Korean to uncover Korean OEM/ODM factories and functional claims. Filter inputs accept English or Korean (common terms like "sunscreen", "Cosmax", "Kolmar" auto-bridge; unmapped English falls back to raw substring match), datasetType selects reported/reviewed/both registries, resolveOemFromReviewed joins reviewed base formulas to expose hidden factories, and maxItems/maxPagesToScan cap scan volume. Queries the live MFDS API (~5-20s; slower when resolveOemFromReviewed joins formulas) with transient retries and bills $2/1K records ($0 if empty). Use for K-Beauty OEM sourcing and R&D; do not use for recall checks (use search_korea_mfds_recalls instead).

datasetType.description: Which MFDS registry to query: "reported" (198k+ brand filings), "reviewed" (20k+ OEM base formulas), or "both".

productName.description: Product keyword in English or Korean (e.g. "sunscreen", "retinol cream", "serum", "선크림") — English auto-translates server-side.

brandOrDistributor.description: Brand or responsible seller in English or Korean, e.g. "Amorepacific", "Olive Young", "Medicube", or "아모레퍼시픽".

oemManufacturer.description: OEM/ODM factory in English or Korean, e.g. "Cosmax", "Kolmar", "Cosmecca", or "코스맥스".

efficacyKeyword.description: Efficacy claim filter in English or Korean: "whitening", "anti-wrinkle", "uv-protection", "SPF", "hair-loss", "미백", "주름".

itemCode.description: Exact MFDS ITEM_SEQ or COSMETIC_REPORT_SEQ identifier for single-product lookup.

resolveOemFromReviewed.description: Query linked reviewed base formulas automatically to reveal hidden OEM/ODM factories when missing on reported filings.

tools.name: audit_local_b2b_websites
tools.description: Audit local SMB websites for technical, SEO, pixel, and DNS deliverability weaknesses, then extract owner emails and factual cold-pitch copy. Supply at least one source (websiteUrls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId + datasetField, sourceRunId, or presetChambers; omitting all returns 0 items at $0); agencyPreset tailors scoring and copy, dedupStoreName persists 16-shard KV snapshots for skip_seen or watch_diff modes, and onlyWithEmail/onlyWithWeakness/minPitchScore filter before billing. Persists KV dedup shards and optional webhookUrl payloads (explaining readOnlyHint=false), isolates per-site WAF/timeout errors in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and bills $4.50/1K leads ($0 on WAF, filtered misses, or skip_seen repeats). Use for local agency prospecting; do not use for SaaS SOC 2 audits (use audit_saas_trust_center) or Meta/DTC ad audits (use audit_meta_ads_advertisers).

tools.name: monitor_ats_hiring_intent

Supply targets, presetPacks, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId, OR leave targets empty with titleKeywords/techStackFilter to auto-trigger global live discovery and Reverse-Pivot; omitting both targets and filters returns 0 items at $0.
